name: Button
summary: Triggers an action or navigation. The single button used everywhere in the system.
replaces: hand-rolled Button markup in app code

name: IconButton
summary: Square icon-only Button with a required accessible label and tooltip title.

name: Chip
summary: Compact tag that can be removable and/or selectable (toggle).
replaces: shadcn-vue Badge used as a removable tag
ad-hoc tag pills with a close icon

name: ShowMore
summary: Collapses long content to a number of lines or a height and shows a Show more toggle only when it overflows.
replaces: hand-rolled line-clamp with a Show more link
read-more toggles written with a boolean ref and a measured height

name: Avatar
summary: Shows a user or entity as an image with an initials fallback and an optional status dot.

name: AvatarGroup
summary: Overlapping stack of avatars with a +N overflow bubble.

name: Icon
summary: Inline SVG renderer for FontAwesome-shaped icon data, decorative by default.

name: Kbd
summary: Keyboard key chip (`<kbd>`) and a group that joins keys with a separator.

name: Separator

name: Skeleton
summary: Placeholder block shown while content loads: text, circle, avatar, pill, rounded, rect and paragraph shapes with a pulse or no animation.

name: Spinner
summary: Small rotating SVG that shows work in progress, with an accessible label or as a purely visual mark.

name: AspectRatio
summary: Keeps its content at a fixed width-to-height ratio (images, video, maps, placeholders).

name: ScrollArea
summary: Scrollable region with consistent, themed scrollbars across browsers.

name: VisuallyHidden
summary: Hides content visually while keeping it available to screen readers.

name: Link

replaces: shadcn-vue style link buttons for text links

name: Badge
summary: Small non-interactive label for status, counts and categories.

name: CountBadge

replaces: hand-rolled notification count bubbles with absolute left/right offsets

name: Progress

name: ProgressRing
summary: Circular SVG meter that fills clockwise from the top, with a centre label.

name: StatusBadge

name: StatusDot

name: Toggle

name: ToggleGroup

name: Markdown

name: Prose

name: Blockquote

name: Eyebrow

name: FormattedNumber

name: Heading

name: InlineCode

name: Lead
summary: Large muted intro paragraph that follows a page or section title.

name: Price

name: Text

name: Section

name: AppShell

name: CenteredLayout

name: PageHeader

name: SplitLayout

name: Affix

name: Grid

name: Spacer

name: Switch

name: ColorPicker

name: Calendar

name: Label

name: Select

name: Slider

name: DateInput
